name: Review Team
tagline: A crew that reads your code and tells you what would actually hurt.
blurb: Talk to the Review Team the way you would talk to a lead: say what you changed and what you are worried about. When you want the real pass, it opens a session and runs the crew, a lead who divides the codebase by what it actually is, and reviewers for architecture, security, tests and correctness. One report comes back, not four.
capabilities: Every finding names a file and a line
Ranked by what would hurt if it shipped

bot.helpsWith: Reviews code with a crew, architecture, security, tests, correctness.
